title: ORAM Configuration
description: The complete configuration format for one repository's oram.config.json, as created by `oram init`. See docs/ORAM_SPECIFICATION_v1.md Section 9 (Configuration Model). Schema only -- loading/validation is not implemented yet (see ORAM_V3_MIGRATION_PLAN.md Milestone 1/2).

version.description: Config schema version. ORAM refuses to load a config whose version it does not recognize, rather than guessing at an upgrade.

repository.description: Repository-identifying metadata, recorded at `oram init` time so a Knowledge Store entry can be attributed even if the repository is later moved or renamed.

name.description: Human-readable project name. Generalizes detectProjectName() in scripts/repository-intelligence.js.

remoteUrl.description: The `git remote origin` URL at init time, if any.

providers.description: Which Providers (docs/ORAM_SPECIFICATION_v1.md Section 6) are available to this repository, and which is used by default.

default.description: The provider id used by `oram run`/`oram execute` when no --provider flag is given. Generalizes EXECUTION_PROVIDER (default: "stub-deterministic-v1" in scripts/implementation-executor.js).

configured.description: Every provider this repository has enabled. At least one entry (typically "stub") is expected to always be present so `oram run` never has zero usable providers.

id.description: A user-chosen identifier for this provider instance, unique within `configured` (a repository may configure the same `kind` twice with different settings).

kind.description: Which Provider implementation this entry configures. See docs/ORAM_SPECIFICATION_v1.md Section 6's reference provider table.

settings.description: Provider-specific, non-secret settings only (e.g. a model identifier, a CLI binary path/args, a timeout). Credentials are NEVER stored here -- they are always resolved from the environment or a secret manager by name, generalizing System B's existing discipline of referencing `secrets.GEMINI_API_KEY` by name only, never inlining a value.

execution.description: Policy governing the Execute phase of the Engineering Lifecycle.

requireApproval.description: Whether a human must explicitly approve a Mission before its Work Order is handed to a Provider. Generalizes EXECUTION_POLICY_DEFAULTS.requireHumanApproval in scripts/implementation-request-engine.js (today: always true, hard-coded). ORAM's Core Philosophy (docs/ORAM_SPECIFICATION_v1.md Section 1.3) treats false as a valid but explicit opt-out, never a silent default.

maxIterations.description: Maximum number of Reflect-recommended retry attempts within one Engineering Cycle. Generalizes GVAMS_MAX_ITERATIONS in scripts/autonomous-orchestrator.js.

gates.description: Quality Gate thresholds (docs/ORAM_SPECIFICATION_v1.md's Quality Gate terminology). Unifies today's Validation Engine rule set with System B's diff-budget gate.

publishing.description: How ORAM opens a pull request once a Mission is validated and approved.

dryRun.description: When true, every publish stage is simulated -- no branch is created, no commit is made, no pull request is opened. Generalizes GITHUB_PUBLISH_DRY_RUN in scripts/github-publisher.js (default: true there as well). ORAM never changes this default silently.

baseBranch.description: Generalizes GITHUB_PUBLISH_BASE_BRANCH. null means "branch from whatever is currently checked out", matching today's documented behavior exactly.

draft.description: Whether the opened pull request is created as a draft. Every existing publisher (publisher/github/client.js) always creates a draft PR today; this field exists so that default is explicit and overridable rather than implicit.

artifacts.description: Where the ArtifactStore (see packages/runtime/src/ArtifactStore.ts) persists this repository's run data.

storage.description: "home" stores runs under a shared ~/.oram/ location (survives the repository being deleted/re-cloned elsewhere); "repository-local" stores them under a gitignored .oram/ directory inside the repository (travels with a clone). See ArtifactStore.ts's own open TODO on this exact decision.

path.description: Override for the storage location above. null means use the default for the selected `storage` mode.

plugins.description: Third-party Plugins enabled for this repository (docs/ORAM_SPECIFICATION_v1.md Section 10). Each entry is a resolvable package name.
